newsitem.title: UK: Brady bonds up as currency concerns recede.
newsitem.headline: Brady bonds up as currency concerns recede.

text.p: Brady bond prices continued to recoup losses suffered earlier this week as currency concerns faded and investors shifted their focus to the U.S. Treasury market, analysts said on Thursday.

"The scare is pretty much over. Everyone is breathing a sigh of relief. We may go back to Treasury watching which is certainly very supportive," said Peter West, chief economist at BBV Latinvest in London.
